There is something about Northeast India that captures the imagination of travelers worldwide. For those planning a trip to Northeast India, this guide will show you the best of what awaits.

## Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to explore Northeast India depends on what you want to experience. Winter transforms the landscape into a magical wonderland.

## Top Attractions

- Famous attractions that define Northeast India
- Hidden gems only locals know about
- Cultural sites that tell the story of India
- Scenic lookouts for unforgettable photos

![Northeast India landscape](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1568644577260-0568ed0217e0?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Local Cuisine

No trip to Northeast India is complete without sampling the local food. From street-side vendors to fine dining establishments, the culinary scene reflects the region's rich heritage and innovative spirit.

## Getting Around

A mix of public transport and occasional taxis offers the best balance of convenience and cost in Northeast India.

## Where to Stay

Homestays are a great way to immerse yourself in local culture while visiting Northeast India.
